extraFacts.fact: NPTF (Dryseal) is a taper pipe thread cut so the crests and roots close up as the joint is tightened, so it seals on the thread (ASME B1.20.3).
NPT is a tapered pipe thread with a 60° thread angle that is not interchangeable with 55° BSPT; hydraulic NPT joints are normally sealed with PTFE tape or an anaerobic sealant.
extraFacts.source: ASME B1.20.1; Indus Hydraulics NPT adapter listings and guide /blog/stopping-an-npt-thread-leak

extraFacts.fact: NPSM is a straight (parallel) pipe thread for mechanical joints (ASME B1.20.1): it does not seal on the thread, so an NPSM swivel end seals on its seat, which on these Dixon swivels is a 30° seat.
extraFacts.source: ASME B1.20.1; Dixon swivel listing feature note (female NPSM swivel seals on a 30° seat)

extraFacts.fact: SAE 45° flare and inverted-flare fittings (SAE J512) seal on a 45° seat, which differs from the 37° JIC seat and does not mate with it.
An SAE O-ring boss (ORB) port seals on an O-ring compressed in the port; the thread only holds the fitting in place (SAE J1926, ISO 11926).
A crimp fitting is rated only on the hose series it is designed for; the fitting, ferrule and crimp specification are checked against the hose before supply.
extraFacts.source: Indus Hydraulics Aeroquip/Dixon crimp fitting listings (Hose and fitting match note)
